notes: One handwritten sheet on printed Institut des Hautes Études Scientifiques stationery contains three editorial reminders: SGA 5 / XIII on the crystalline case and congruence formulae mod p; IV on the relative case and consultation of VII and SGA 6 / X; and XIV with a parenthesized Problems-and-Commentaries title and a reminder about mod p and crystalline variants, followed by a reference to a note or notes concerning th. de Katz. The first two entries have darker, broader strokes than the lower entry; no writing instrument or named hand is inferred. The only visible numerical page label is the archive number 52 at the bottom left; there is no authorial page number and no date, signature, running title beyond the entry headings, or explicit authorial doubt sign. There is one cancelled unreadable item, one grouping bracket, one printed rule, no marginal note, no insertion and no mathematical diagram. The bold 5 records its unusually broad strokes. H is a textual witness for this page; its descriptive letterhead and bracket notes are distinguished from actual transcribed print/drawing. Reader uncertainty is not attributed to the author. Eight distinct unresolved-at-half places were cropped once each; Faire was resolved by its crop, while the other seven places retain uncertainty or illegibility.
math_reading_decisions: The five Roman references are read XIII, IV, VII, X and XIV from their individual strokes, with separate upper and lower bars preserved at each occurrence.
Both mod p expressions consist of the word mod followed by lowercase p with a descender. No formula, modulus exponent, relation sign or additional mathematical condition is supplied.

The page gives editorial instructions and a reference to th. de Katz rather than a theorem with a proof. No mathematical consistency computation or proof verification was performed; the reference and the intended expansion of th. remain unchecked.
